brief:
Israeli military intelligence has intensified focus on Libya amid growing Turkish military and political presence in the region, according to the Shehab Wire. The occupation army's intelligence unit, Aman, has expanded surveillance of what the Hebrew site describes as the "Libya corridor," tracking developments that could have regional implications.

Turkey has expanded its footprint in Libya in recent years, including military deployments and diplomatic engagement. Israeli officials assess the Turkish activities as potentially affecting the balance of power in the eastern Mediterranean.
dek: Israeli military intelligence has intensified focus on Libya amid growing Turkish military and political presence in the region, according to the Shehab Wire.
title: Israel monitors Turkish military expansion in Libya and Mediterranean
